**Sensitivity Indices for Bad Policy Costs (Tier 1)**

Regression-based sensitivity showing which inputs explain the most variance in the output.

| Input Parameter | Sensitivity Coefficient | Interpretation |
|:----------------|------------------------:|:---------------|
| Bad Policy Cost US Housing Zoning | 0.4222 | Moderate driver |
| Bad Policy Cost US Healthcare Inefficiency | 0.2098 | Weak driver |
| Bad Policy Cost US Failed Wars | 0.1332 | Weak driver |
| Bad Policy Cost US Tax Compliance | 0.0746 | Minimal effect |
| Bad Policy Cost US Tariffs | 0.0697 | Minimal effect |
| Bad Policy Cost US Drug War | 0.0398 | Minimal effect |
| Bad Policy Cost US Agricultural Subsidies | 0.0324 | Minimal effect |
| Bad Policy Cost US Fossil Fuel Explicit | 0.0209 | Minimal effect |

*Interpretation*: Standardized coefficients show the change in output (in SD units) per 1 SD change in input. Values near ±1 indicate strong influence; values exceeding ±1 may occur with correlated inputs.
